featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: S K
featured_reviews.review_text:
I choosed the space fitness in Juhu because it was close to my home and that area 1 of the good but small fitness center. I made a lot of research and i decided to made a trial class which its 2000 for week. After that my friend and me bought a membership for 1 month to know them better. We loved the instructors (Amit one of them). Very motivating and helping , teaching, very lovely people. They know what they are doing. Yoga instructors also good. It was saying unlimited i thought i can join yoga and another class too but sadly unlimited promise is means only 1 time a day 1 class. So not really unlimited, promise was false. I paid cash we got the buddy discount which was very nice that made us cared by them and felt special. Because when you wanna join a fitness center you want to feel that, caring by from the people who is managing. We really liked it, almost everyday we join the classes. When the renewing  came i contacted with them and explained to them i cant pay online i will pay cash like first time i did. And they are offering %8 discount. I dont know who is dealing with membership department but that person failed to do that their job. They told me they cant accept cash if i don’t pay  online they will not give me a deal. Which they did in the beginning . He/she told me “ if you do 2/3 months membership you can pay cash and you will get %10 off. That’s very not good behaving. I explain them. I dont  wanna do that because when i have longer period of time, some how im ending up not going everyday. Sometimes a full week dont go, because i know i still have many days. Limited time motivates me. He/she said “ sorry we cant help you unless you make longer membership. They end up lost 2 members which  we would be very beneficial for them to have us . We can reach many woman groups. They preferred to not to help just for 1000 thousand rupee maybe less. Owner Gigi is very lovely person but i think  she just doesnt have time to manage the membership plans or supervise them. Because this was the worst membership experience ever. This people dont know what they are doing really. Feels like someone 20 years old trying to recruit the members in a very wrong  way. Thanx for the 5 weeks. I hope for your sake and all that great instructors sake just  in the future will plan  carefully about “ how to keep the members happy and make them come back again”they failed to do that for some  silly reasons .

featured_reviews.name: Helina Vora
featured_reviews.review_text: If there was a 10 star option I would give that! I was never really into fitness but the vibe of this gym is so good it keeps me motivated to wake up every morning and show up for the class. My fitness levels have reached from 0 to 10 thanks to The Space! Everyone here right from the owner - Gigi to all the coaches - Coach Apoorv, Amit and Raki are genuinely helpful and always making great efforts to give personalized attention to everyone whether it is a group class or PT. All the workouts here are unique and they do their best to ensure that they don’t get monotonous and are always fun. My day feels incomplete when I miss the class. The Space is the best thing that has happened to me in my fitness journey :)

Thank you for your kind review Helina!

featured_reviews.review_text: The Space for me, has not only been the best place to start my fitness journey but also a safe haven of calm, good mental health and the best energies. featured_reviews.name: Avnee Kokatay
featured_reviews.review_text:
Getting a membership at The Space is literally the single best thing I have done for myself in my life!
The studio, the aesthetics, the vibe, the training and the PEOPLE!!! It is by far the most effective combination ever. Not only has it worked wonders for my physical fitness but my mental and emotional wellness as well. featured_reviews.review_text: Spaces Gym provides a fantastic training experience, and Coach Rakesh is exceptional. featured_reviews.name: Dilesh Lakhani
featured_reviews.review_text: I made an enquiry about online training, and the entire experience was underwhelming. There was no initial call or proper discussion, responses were slow, and I was asked to make payment upfront before even speaking to a coach. The process felt overly focused on money rather than client care. Overall, the service came across as unprofessional and driven by sales rather than genuine care. It appears everything is driven by money at Tribe Fitness and therefore I wouldn’t recommend

featured_reviews.name: Niyati Gandhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I discovered the Tribe in 2024 and signed up for group sessions and personal training.

The group workouts are challenging but designed so everyone can work at their own level. The programming is varied—you never get bored, but there's enough consistency to track real progress. The coaches emphasize proper form and scaling options for all the levels of fitness you will experience. My personal trainer Viraj is exceptional - he not only took the effort to understand and program for my fitness goals but took the effort to understand who I am and what motivates me.

Most importantly, the Tribe has helped me rediscover my love for fitness.I genuinely look forward to showing up. Whether it's the high-fives after a tough workout, the supportive messages in our group chat, runners club or the community events - UTC, Match Day - they've created something special here. The emphasis and experience of community is amazing. Any trainer who may be at the studio when you are - will help you get stronger and better. Most people you work out along side will suffer with you and laugh with you - maybe you will make a new friend.

If you're looking for more than just a place to work out—if you want a supportive community that will celebrate your victories and push you when you just cannot or don’t want to—this is your place.

featured_reviews.review_text: Tribe has been a game-changer for me, thanks to my trainer Nikhil. He’s knowledgeable, motivating, and tailors workouts to my goals. Highly recommend Tribe and Nikhil for anyone serious about fitness!

featured_reviews.review_text:
I took one year membership and i hardly went to the gym.

Before my wedding i took personal training.

During one of the sessions, one other trainer threw a bench at us, it hit both me as well my trainer. I was in shock as i had never even seen that person earlier maybe the trainers had some rivalry or something i still have no clue.

I went to the gym management immediately and they did nothing and i was hit, i was lucky it hit my leg but it could have been my head as earlier i was lying down and doing another variation and i had my wedding in 15 days.

I kept insisting them to take action but they did nothing i waited for almost an hour after my workout was disturbed then finally i had to call the police on 100 and the cops came and took both me and the trainer who assaulted me  in a van, i had never sat in one in my life, and my trainer also came later to give his side of the story as even he was hit by the bench, even on the way the other trainer abused a lot and threatened with dire consequences, they sent me for medical at baba hospital and then i submitted everything and left but no action was taken as the cop said the gym owner is an influential person.

No one from the gym management did anything they even told the cops it’s another trainer who did it and they can’t be held responsible for it hence no complaint can be filed against them.

I had 6 months of my membership left but it didn’t feel like it’s a safe place because management did nothing they didn’t even provide the footage of the person throwing the bench even when there is a cctv in the gym and he kept abusing me and laughing when ever i went to the gym after this happened, i was a paying customer at the gym and he was just a trainer and management did nothing.

After I complained, when ever i went to the gym the valet handed me over the keys never got the car back to gate and one of the time the car tyres were flat that’s when i decided on leaving the gym and i had to discontinue the personal training also.

The gym was really good and equipment is good also and they have everything you need except a 45Degree leg press, good crowd, there is valet parking service as well, it’s also the most VFM gym in the area, building is really bad in terms of cleanliness, there are cockroaches everywhere because there are lot of eateries, gym was super clean though but what happened came as a shock to me and i never went back even for a single day even though i had 6 months remaining on my membership subscription because safety was an issue, what if the guy hit the bench on my head while i was working out while lying down how would i protect myself, so you can imagine the trauma and no one goes to the gym to fight, in-fact i am always running short on time so I don’t even interact much i just leave as soon as i am done. Those days i was preparing for my wedding so i had 1000 things to do and they troubled me at that time so you can imagine what’s the mentality of the gym managment.

For me to go to the police station and then medical examination at baba hospital was like trauma because ideally the managment should have taken action, instead of compelling me to call the cops and my whole day was wasted i had to skip my clothes trial fitting appoint that day i remember and you also get unnecessarily stressed.

When i had joined the gym they made me read a lengthy document on gym rules but their trainer didn’t follow the same and they did nothing at all.

I am paying exactly double the amount per person  i paid at 360 but i am at peace when i work out at the current gym, there is no security concern or threat.

my personal trainer was outstanding he made me achieve my goal of looking fit for my wedding in less than a month i could have gotten better as this incident spoiled our momentum and discontinued, he even came to the police station with me and narrated the truth to them.

So if anything happens in the gym, management will do nothing they will shrug off any responsibility or accountability so please keep this in mind before joining.

featured_reviews.name: Sunny Kothari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Owner of Creative Stepz Studio,

I hope this message finds you well. I want to express my gratitude for reaching out and requesting feedback regarding my recent experience at your studio. I appreciate your willingness to listen to the concerns of your visitors and work towards creating a better environment for all.

1. While I understand that mosquitoes are prevalent in our city, I do believe that more effort can be made to fumigate the area in the studio's compound. It appears that this space is somehow particularly attractive to mosquitoes. I don't wish to single out your studio, but addressing this issue could significantly enhance the overall experience for all your visitors.

2. One of the main concerns I encountered during my visit was related to the restroom facilities. My 3-year-old child needed to use the restroom, and the only available option seemed to be a common restroom shared with the security personnel. I have no problem with the shared restroom concept, but it's crucial that cleanliness and hygiene are maintained. Unfortunately, the condition of the restroom left much to be desired - there was urine on the seat, a lack of tissues, urine on the floor, an unpleasant odor, and no hand tissues for drying. Ensuring the cleanliness and hygiene of such shared facilities is essential.

3. The most significant issue I encountered was the behavior of the watchman. I understand the need to keep classes on schedule, but the approach taken by the watchman was quite hostile. Turning off the air conditioners and banging on doors to rush people out of the studio can be quite distressing, especially when there are young children present. It's important to remember that children may require a little extra time to gather their things.

In conclusion, I've taken the step of requesting the activity provider to move out of your space because I believe it's not a safe environment for my child, and the basic amenities, like a clean restroom, are not being provided. Given the prime location of your studio, I had higher expectations.

I hope this feedback is taken in the best spirit and that it leads to improvements that benefit all visitors. Thank you for your attention to these concerns, and I hope to see positive changes in the near future.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Dropped in here last week. Pros: It’s a decent space. Front desk staff were helpful and friendly. Clean.

Cons: They need more squat racks. Some of the equipment is strange and the numbers do not correspond to the correct weights.

**MOST importantly, this gym has the problem that many Indian gyms have: male trainers who need to re-learn how to interact with women. I was benching alone and while I was doing my very light warmup weight, a trainer came up behind me and reached to spot me without asking. I was NOWHERE close to failing, nor was I in danger. Spotting someone on bench press means, to put it crudely, hanging your crotch over their face, and potentially touching their chest/breast if you do need to help. I am simply stunned that anyone would think it’s appropriate to come so close to me without seeking consent. Mere minutes later, another trainer approached me when I was in the middle of a rep on a machine to try to talk to me. Anyone who has ever been to a gym understands that you DO NOT speak to someone when they are in the middle of a rep. It is dangerous. I have been weightlifting for 11 years and do not need help from these men; if I need help, I will ask. (Fun fact: the guy who seemed poised to correct me was later spotted giving genuinely awful advice to someone else on how to perform a squat, so I didn’t want his help anyway.) I would strongly suggest to I think fitness a new set of protocols so their trainers do not behave this way in the future.

featured_reviews.review_text:
The training style during class comprised a blend of general fitness, functional and strength training with the main focus on kickboxing.

The changes I felt after having joined the class included, but were not limited to an increase in flexibility, more strength and agility, higher levels of stamina and endurance and a general increase in fitness.

My progress throughout the class has accelerated, thanks to the consistent practice and variety of exercises and techniques that we are subjected to each session.

One of my favourite qualities of Kaustubh Sir was his patience and tolerance during each session, and his reluctance to give up on us or let us give up on ourselves. His constant motivation encourages us to keep going and improving.

My feedback regarding the technical style is mostly positive, with a great appreciation for the dedication Kaustubh Sir puts in to explain the technical and scientific principles behind kickboxing to help us better comprehend our anatomy and the fundamental aspects of kickboxing.

featured_reviews.name: brinda shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Every time I go for my training at Resculpt fitness, I always return feeling stronger. The centre is well laid out, clean and this place is a fun alternative to becoming fit while learning different skills.
Coach Kaustubh trains me very well and the best part is that everyone who comes here gets personal attention. The coach ensure that all the workouts are done in a correct manner with the right technique. I’ve been learning an amazing combination of functional along with kick boxing. After a few sessions I could see the desired results and the exercises also helped me improve my overall body posture. This is the most friendly, accommodating and motivating facility.
Overall, flexible schedule and so much more than just boxing. Whatever your goal is- whether you want to lose weight or just get strong Resculpt fitness will help you achieve it!

featured_reviews.name: vedika dave
featured_reviews.review_text:
The training style was a main focus on kickboxing with inclusions of strength training and general fitness.

The changes I felt after joining the class were an increase in stability, strenght, endurance, and a general increase in physically fitness.

My progress throught the class has drastically changed. At the beginning of the class my physical strength was less though soon after consistency and hard work I was able to see  major improvements in my  strength and ability to perform.

Kaustubh Bornare’s training quality is something that I liked. I enjoyed his warm up and intensivity of trainings. He always tries to include trainings which positively fit you best that are enjoying as well.m.

The training style and technicality was mostly positive and highly advanced. The style was altered and personalized based on our needs.

featured_reviews.name: Anirudh Rajagopalan
featured_reviews.review_text:
The overall experience is absolutely wonderful and engaging, you do end up feeling tired by the end of it but you keep coming back for more because you see genuine progress. No two classes are the same, you have multiple exercises and body parts tackled in a session which makes it very holistic in every sense.

The training approach of Kaustubh is very straightforward, he's extremely vocal and ensures that technique is always taking precedence over anything else. It's a simple mantra, you give it your all, he'll give you his all!

I've definitely seen a massive increase in stamina and endurance since I've joined his classes, plus, it's also helping me achieve a much more leaner figure and helping me lose fats in those areas that are naturally stubborn to be lost.

His guidance has seen me gain a lot of muscle mass and get proper toning across major body parts, that's really boosted my confidence manifold!

I would urge everyone to give this a shot! The first few lessons maybe difficult but it starts becoming addictive in a week's time, plus, you end up making great friends, have a trainer for your lifetime and the cherry on top is a better body and a healthy life!

featured_reviews.name: Varun Rungta
featured_reviews.review_text: Been training with Resculpt fitness for over 3 months now and it’s been one of the best training experiences. Have really improved strength, stamina, and kickboxing techniques. The thing I like most about training with Kaustubh is his focus on technique, which pays off over the long run as your intensity goes up. It has been the only class to keep me engaged for this long and make it a part of my habit.

It's hard nowadays to find someone who knows what they are doing and is passionate about it, and I would recommend this place to anyone looking to be fit and healthy.
